{{CSGO}}: 2019-09-26 |disbanded=2024-01-08 }} '''Evil Geniuses''' (often abbreviated as '''EG''') is a professional gaming organization founded in Victoria, [[:category:Canada|Canada]] in 1999, making them one of the oldest esports brands still active in the scene. The organization initially entered ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' in the early 2000s, hosting various rosters until 2011. Their successful period in the game came in 2009 when they signed [[compLexity Gaming]]'s former roster, going on to notably win [[Intel_Extreme_Masters/Season_IV/American_Championship_Finals|IEM IV American Championship Finals]] over [[compLexity Gaming]] and besting [[Fnatic]] at [[BeatIt/2010|Beat it! 2010]]. In 2012, '''Evil Geniuses''' shut down their ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' division, beginning a seven year hiatus from the game. In 2015, '''Evil Geniuses''' attempted to sign the [[GX]] squad but the deal fell through after the majority of the team received a lifetime ban from Valve events for their involvement in the [[North American match fixing scandal]]. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/13995/ex-ibp-involved-in-betting-scandal|title=ex-iBP involved in betting scandal|date=2015-01-17|author=[[MIRAA]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} On September 26, 2019, '''Evil Geniuses''' entered ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' with the acquisition of [[NRG Esports]]' roster. ==Timeline== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=2001 |name2=2006 |name3=2007 |name4=2008 |name5=2009 |name6=2010 |name7=2011 |name8=2012 |name9=2019 |name10=2020 |name11=2021 |name12=2022 |name13=2023 |name14=2024 |This=14 |content1= *October 19th - '''Evil Geniuses''' open its ''Counter-Strike'' division. {{cite web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030729130010/http://www.shackes.com/news_archive_overview.x/2001/10/19|title=Evil Geniuses Counter-Strike|date=2001-10-19|publisher=[[Shackes]]}} |content2= *November 6th - '''Evil Geniuses''' part ways with [[da_bears]], who leaves for [[zEx]], and sign [[Royle]]. {{cite web|url=https://fragbite.se/cs/news/11603/royle-ersatter-da-bears-i-evil-geniuses|title=Royle ersätter da bears i Evil Geniuses|trans_title=Royle replaces da bear in Evil Geniuses|language={{Flag|se}} Swedish|date=2006-11-06|author=[[flpee]]|publisher=[[Fragbite]]}} |content3= *January 11th - '''Evil Geniuses''' part ways with [[Lin (Canadian player)|Lin]] and acquire [[Grt]] from [[Team Pandemic]] and [[tr1p]].
